item.title: Hate Now Brief's music recommendations? One UI 8.5 could bring a fix
item.description: Spotify playlists and YouTube videos recommended by Now Brief on Samsung phones were not good, but they will improve with One UI 8.5.

item.title: Samsung's new T7 SSD has a unique Galaxy connection
item.description: Samsung has launched the SSD T7 Resurrected, which is made using 100% recycled aluminum. It also has a unique connection with Galaxy phones.

item.title: You can now buy Samsung's Movingstyle portable TV in the UK
item.description: Samsung has now launched The Movingstyle portable TV with a 27-inch screen in the UK. It has a handle that you can use to carry the TV.

item.title: Samsung to unveil even faster HBM4 chip early next year
item.description: Samsung will reportedly unveil an even faster HBM4 chip at the International Solid-State Circuits Conference (ISSCC) in February 2026.

item.title: These leaked Galaxy S26 Ultra wallpapers may have a secret
item.description: Purported Galaxy S26 Ultra wallpapers have been leaked online and they have a secret hint about the device's color options at launch.

item.title: There's still time left on these great Samsung Black Friday 2025 US deals
item.description: Samsung Black Friday 2025 US deals are still live, but the time to pick up your next device at a discount is quickly running out.

item.title: YouTube videos shared via Messages app on Galaxy phones will look better
item.description: All Samsung Galaxy phones come pre-installed with the Google Messages app. YouTube videos shared via the app are about to look better.

item.title: Apple turns to Intel instead of Samsung for its low-end MacBook chips
item.description: Apple is reportedly beginning tests of Intel’s 18A fabrication process and plans to begin using it for M series chips in 2027.

item.title: How do phone recording features work for voice memos?
item.description: Learn how phone recording features capture and process voice memos through microphones, digital conversion, and compression. Discover tips to improve audio quality.

item.title: What are the essential phone accessibility features?
item.description: Discover essential phone accessibility features including screen readers, live captions, and voice control. Learn how these smartphone tools help everyone use devices more easily.
